title: Emitter machine configuration
statement: For a Boolean input list $w$, an emitter state $s$, an index $i$ at most the length of $w$, and an output list, form a configuration whose machine state is the read phase specified by $s$, whose input-head position is the shifted position $i+1$, and whose three work tapes and their head positions are given by the components of $s$. Its output tape contains the supplied output list.
caveat: The supplied definition of the emitter state has no vector component, although the formal body refers to one; that reference cannot be rendered unambiguously.
